task_summary: Make the EStG-150 LLM-assisted human-review tool operational for record-by-record review: (1) introduce validate_doc_dict (pure in-memory validator) so save_draft can validate before any disk write; (2) refactor service.save_draft to auto-validate the in-memory doc, back up the on-disk file, atomically write, and return the validation report; (3) refactor GUI on_save to consume the validation result from save_draft; (4) add 6 new service-layer tests covering the new auto-validation, counter, immutability, span-ID-uniqueness, and actor_action_map/order_relations reference contract; (5) emit a precise task-scoped changeset; no real LLM/API call and no human review decisions imported.

files_modified.role: Add validate_doc_dict(doc, hashes_path) pure function that mirrors validate_global but operates on an in-memory doc (no human_correction file read). Refactor validate_global to call validate_doc_dict after reading. Add _resolve_hashes_path helper.

Refactor save_draft to (1) validate in-memory doc with validate_doc_dict (pure Python, no production file overwrite), (2) create a unique-name backup of the on-disk file, (3) atomically write the in-memory doc, (4) return {saved, backup, path, validation}. Import validate_doc_dict and _resolve_hashes_path from the validator module.

Refactor ReviewerApp.on_save to consume the validation result returned by service.save_draft (rather than calling validate_global separately), and surface the three readiness booleans (format_valid / review_ready / freeze_ready) plus the 150-progress counters in the post-save status message. Drafts that are format-invalid still save; the message guides the user to the backup for recovery.

Add 6 new service-layer tests: test_save_draft_returns_validation_report (validation result shape), test_save_draft_validates_in_memory_before_disk_write (in-memory mutation flagged before write), test_save_draft_counters_reflect_in_memory_state (n_reviewed/records_fully_decided counters), test_continuous_add_span_no_duplicate_id (cross-field ID uniqueness for conditions/constraints/exceptions), test_actor_action_map_and_order_relations_references_legal (validator catches unknown IDs, real IDs pass), test_save_draft_does_not_modify_layer_b_or_layer_c (immutable layers untouched).

workflow_invariants_enforced: Per-record validation: validate_record_for_review is a pure function on a single record; the first record can be marked reviewed while the other 149 are still needs_review (no chicken-and-egg deadlock).
Global aggregator: validate_doc_dict / validate_global only report readiness booleans and counters; they never block the first-record mark.

Save-before-validate: save_draft validates the in-memory doc first (pure Python, no production overwrite), then backs up the on-disk file, then atomically writes; the production file is never replaced by an invalid state without a backup existing first.
Incomplete draft is allowed: an in-progress or format-invalid draft can be saved; only an explicit mark_reviewed call (per-record eligible) moves the state forward.
Backup naming: UTC-microsecond timestamp + per-backup-dir monotonic counter; two saves in the same microsecond produce two different filenames.
LLM candidate immutability: layers A/B/C/D are read-only and SHA-256 unchanged before and after the task.
Layer E initial state preserved: 0/150 approved_en, 0/150 reviewed, 0/150 adjudicated; the editable file is byte-identical pre- and post-task.
Chinese aid not fabricated: Layer D fields remain null; the GUI shows the explicit '尚未生成' banner; tests verify aid_source=pending_authorized_llm_call and model=null; no real LLM/API call was made.
Audit warning: review_aids_zh_not_generated is still emitted by audit_project.py so the review tool can never silently claim the Chinese-aided workflow is ready.
